records.statement: DriveWealth/Ripple announced RLUSD settlement on XRPL and related payments/custody work, but the integration remains unverified in production. Stablecoin funding of brokerage collateral accounts does not establish native XRP collateral, XRP bridge routing or meaningful XRP demand.
records.impact: Conflating RLUSD settlement, stablecoin-funded collateral accounts, XRPL network fees and native XRP bridge/collateral demand would overstate XRP adoption and actual capital flows.
unresolved: European production cutover date, participating legal entities and supported jurisdictions.
Daily RLUSD settlement volume, mint/burn totals and active partner/customer counts.
Actual collateral-account asset balances, accepted stablecoins, conversion fees, haircuts and utilization.
Whether any DriveWealth corridor uses XRP as a bridge asset rather than RLUSD-only settlement.
XRPL transaction count, fee burn and XRP account-reserve changes attributable to this integration.
US expansion date and product scope.
Whether Ripple Prime Delta One equity-financing exploration becomes a signed and operating facility.
